name: My Factorio Server
description: A Factorio server hosted on GCP
_comment_max_players: Maximum number of players allowed, 0 means unlimited
_comment_visibility: public: Game will be published on the official Factorio matching server
_comment_credentials: Your factorio.com login credentials. Required for public visibility
_comment_token: Authentication token. May be used instead of password above
_comment_game_password: Password required to join the game
_comment_require_user_verification: When true, only users with a valid Factorio.com account can join
_comment_minimum_latency_in_ticks: One tick is 16ms in default game speed, 0 means no minimum
_comment_max_heartbeats_per_second: Network tick rate. High value might improve latency but uses more bandwidth
_comment_ignore_player_limit_for_returni: Players that played on this map already can join even when max_players is reached
_comment_autosave_slots: Server autosave slots, cycled when saving
_comment_afk_autokick_interval: AFK players kick interval in minutes, 0 to disable
_comment_auto_pause: Pause when no players are connected
_comment_autosave_only_on_server: Whether autosaves should be saved only on server or also on all connected clients
_comment_minimum_segment_size: Long network messages are split into segments. Increase for high-latency connections
